"""Ordered-storage module: versioned copy-on-write treaps (protocol 3.0).

Two node layouts are used, both plain lists so that copying a node is a single
slice and an isolated checkpoint of a whole structure is one root reference:

  lean  [key, rec, prio, left, right, stamp]                   bank PIFOs
  fat   [key, rec, prio, left, right, size, val, lazy, stamp]  global live set

``key``   ordering key; ``(rank, ordinal)`` tuples for both layouts.
``rec``   the packet record that occupies the node.
``prio``  treap priority (deterministic, structural only).
``size``  subtree population (fat layout), used for rank-order statistics.
``val``   the node's own accumulated lag (fat layout).
``lazy``  a pending lag addition for every node of the subtree (fat layout).
``stamp`` version the node was produced in.  A node is copied before its first
          mutation in a later version, so saved checkpoints stay immutable while
          taking or reloading a checkpoint costs O(1).

Lag is stored as ``val + lazy`` per node, therefore "every remaining strictly
lower-rank resident gains one lag" is a single O(depth) subtree operation and
never walks the backlog.
"""

M64 = (1 << 64) - 1


class Priors:
    """Deterministic treap priority source; structure only, never observable."""

    __slots__ = ('state',)

    def __init__(self, seed=0x243F6A8885A308D3):
        self.state = seed & M64

    def take(self):
        s = self.state = (self.state + 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) & M64
        z = s ^ (s >> 30)
        z = (z * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9) & M64
        z ^= z >> 27
        z = (z * 0x94D049BB133111EB) & M64
        return z ^ (z >> 31)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- lean layout


def lean_insert(node, key, rec, prio, ver):
    if node is None:
        return [key, rec, prio, None, None, ver]
    node = node[:] if node[5] != ver else node
    if key < node[0]:
        node[3] = lean_insert(node[3], key, rec, prio, ver)
        child = node[3]
        if child[2] > node[2]:
            node[3] = child[4]
            child[4] = node
            return child
    else:
        node[4] = lean_insert(node[4], key, rec, prio, ver)
        child = node[4]
        if child[2] > node[2]:
            node[4] = child[3]
            child[3] = node
            return child
    return node


def lean_merge(a, b, ver):
    if a is None:
        return b
    if b is None:
        return a
    if a[2] > b[2]:
        a = a[:] if a[5] != ver else a
        a[4] = lean_merge(a[4], b, ver)
        return a
    b = b[:] if b[5] != ver else b
    b[3] = lean_merge(a, b[3], ver)
    return b


def lean_delete(node, key, ver):
    if node is None:
        return None
    node = node[:] if node[5] != ver else node
    if key < node[0]:
        node[3] = lean_delete(node[3], key, ver)
    elif key > node[0]:
        node[4] = lean_delete(node[4], key, ver)
    else:
        return lean_merge(node[3], node[4], ver)
    return node


def lean_extract_min(node, ver):
    """Return (new root, node) for the smallest key; ``node`` must be live."""
    node = node[:] if node[5] != ver else node
    left = node[3]
    if left is None:
        return node[4], node
    node[3], out = lean_extract_min(left, ver)
    return node, out


def lean_extract_max(node, ver):
    """Return (new root, node) for the largest key; ``node`` must be live."""
    node = node[:] if node[5] != ver else node
    right = node[4]
    if right is None:
        return node[3], node
    node[4], out = lean_extract_max(right, ver)
    return node, out


def lean_find(node, key):
    while node is not None:
        k = node[0]
        if k == key:
            return node
        node = node[3] if key < k else node[4]
    return None


def lean_recs(node, out):
    """Append records in key order (loop on the right spine)."""
    while node is not None:
        lean_recs(node[3], out)
        out.append(node[1])
        node = node[4]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- fat layout


def _fat_push(node, ver):
    """Move ``node.lazy`` into its own value and both children (copy-on-write)."""
    lz = node[7]
    node[6] += lz
    node[7] = 0
    left = node[3]
    if left is not None:
        left = left[:] if left[8] != ver else left
        left[7] += lz
        node[3] = left
    right = node[4]
    if right is not None:
        right = right[:] if right[8] != ver else right
        right[7] += lz
        node[4] = right


def fat_insert(node, key, rec, prio, ver):
    if node is None:
        return [key, rec, prio, None, None, 1, 0, 0, ver]
    node = node[:] if node[8] != ver else node
    if node[7]:
        _fat_push(node, ver)
    if key < node[0]:
        node[3] = fat_insert(node[3], key, rec, prio, ver)
        node[5] += 1
        child = node[3]
        if child[2] > node[2]:
            node[3] = child[4]
            node[5] = 1 + (node[3][5] if node[3] is not None else 0) \
                        + (node[4][5] if node[4] is not None else 0)
            child[4] = node
            child[5] = 1 + node[5] + (child[3][5] if child[3] is not None else 0)
            return child
    else:
        node[4] = fat_insert(node[4], key, rec, prio, ver)
        node[5] += 1
        child = node[4]
        if child[2] > node[2]:
            node[4] = child[3]
            node[5] = 1 + (node[3][5] if node[3] is not None else 0) \
                        + (node[4][5] if node[4] is not None else 0)
            child[3] = node
            child[5] = 1 + node[5] + (child[4][5] if child[4] is not None else 0)
            return child
    return node


def fat_merge(a, b, ver):
    if a is None:
        return b
    if b is None:
        return a
    if a[2] > b[2]:
        a = a[:] if a[8] != ver else a
        if a[7]:
            _fat_push(a, ver)
        a[4] = fat_merge(a[4], b, ver)
        a[5] = 1 + (a[3][5] if a[3] is not None else 0) \
                  + (a[4][5] if a[4] is not None else 0)
        return a
    b = b[:] if b[8] != ver else b
    if b[7]:
        _fat_push(b, ver)
    b[3] = fat_merge(a, b[3], ver)
    b[5] = 1 + (b[3][5] if b[3] is not None else 0) \
              + (b[4][5] if b[4] is not None else 0)
    return b


def fat_pop(node, key, thr, ver, acc):
    """Remove ``key`` from the live set.

    ``thr`` is the served rank: when given, every remaining entry of strictly
    smaller rank gains one lag and is counted, which yields rank_error in the
    same descent.  Returns ``(new root, lag of the removed entry, count)``.
    """
    node = node[:] if node[8] != ver else node
    acc += node[7]
    k = node[0]
    if k == key:
        lag = acc + node[6]
        if node[7]:
            _fat_push(node, ver)
        return fat_merge(node[3], node[4], ver), lag, 0
    if k < key:
        add = thr is not None and k[0] < thr
        if add:
            node[6] += 1
            left = node[3]
            if left is not None:
                left = left[:] if left[8] != ver else left
                left[7] += 1
                node[3] = left
        node[4], lag, cnt = fat_pop(node[4], key, thr, ver, acc)
        if add:
            cnt += 1 + (node[3][5] if node[3] is not None else 0)
        node[5] -= 1
        return node, lag, cnt
    node[3], lag, cnt = fat_pop(node[3], key, thr, ver, acc)
    node[5] -= 1
    return node, lag, cnt


def fat_lag(root, key):
    """Lag of ``key`` or None when the entry is absent (read-only descent)."""
    acc = 0
    node = root
    while node is not None:
        acc += node[7]
        k = node[0]
        if k == key:
            return acc + node[6]
        node = node[3] if key < k else node[4]
    return None


def fat_pairs(node, acc, out):
    """Append ``(rec, lag)`` pairs in key order (loop on the right spine)."""
    while node is not None:
        a = acc + node[7]
        fat_pairs(node[3], a, out)
        out.append((node[1], a + node[6]))
        node = node[4]
        acc = a
PYEOF
